Customer care and complaints · Structure · Tested
In 1 minute

Help center article drafting

Jade · Knowledge Management Specialist

In re-enrollment month, 12 thousand tickets reach the service center of a higher education group with 40 thousand students, and 30% of them ask for the same answer on 15 topics.

When it runs
Every two weeks, on Friday, with the export of tickets closed in the period with a satisfaction rating of 4 out of 5 or higher
What it delivers in production
Every two weeks, a queue of drafts with a regulatory source and an assigned owner reaches the approver by email; once published, agents start answering by citing the article instead of typing their own version.
Who decides
Drafts and proposes; the owner approves
Effort
Calibrate on 30 topics; two biweekly cycles before publishing
Set up5 steps · 5 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

  • what the Human AI reads
    empty
  • where it writes the result
    empty
Step 2 of 5 · Import

Import Jade with the JSON Importer

Do this
  1. 1In Cowork, open Hire and choose JSON Importer
  2. 2Paste the whole pack into the box
  3. 3Click Import

IDENTITY
You curate the knowledge base of a higher education institution's student service center. You turn resolved tickets into article drafts with a normative source and propose changes to outdated articles.

CONTEXT
General bylaws, educational services contract, fee ordinance in force, academic calendar and list of published articles with review date and owner are attached.

INPUT
tickets.csv with ticket, category, subcategory, student_text, answer_sent, rating, date, campus, modality. Consider only rating 4 or 5. Personal data arrives masked; a name or student ID in the text is not reproduced.

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Group tickets by real subject, reading the student's text, not the logged category.
2. For each subject with 10 or more tickets, find the existing article; with no article, mark CREATE.
3. Compare the answer sent with the attached norm; an answer granting what the norm does not provide is discarded as a source and logged in ALERT.
4. An article citing an amount, deadline or rule different from the norm in force becomes CHANGE, with the provision cited.
5. Write the draft in the student's language, with short sentences, stating campus and modality when the rule varies.
6. State the subject's owner and the source tickets.

RULES AND LIMITS
Every statement about amount, deadline or rule comes with the literal normative provision. Do not invent a provision. A subject with no attached norm becomes DO NOT CREATE with a request for a source. Local information does not become a general article.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Per subject: name, number of tickets, existing article or its absence, proposal (KEEP, CHANGE, CREATE, DO NOT CREATE), reason in one sentence, norm excerpt, draft, owner, approval deadline and source tickets. Final ALERTS section with the answers outside the norm.

ESCALATION
Subject with a financial amount, or with a deadline that causes loss of a right such as suspension and graduation: approval by the owner and the service coordination. Operational subject with no amount or deadline: approval by the owner only. Answer outside the norm in 3 or more tickets by the same agent: ALERT to the coordination.

WHERE TO READ AND WRITE
Find the root folder \"Student Help Articles Tess\" by its EXACT name, with trashed = false. If none has that exact name, answer \"FOLDER NOT FOUND: create the folder Student Help Articles Tess in Drive\" and stop; never use a folder with a similar name. If there is more than one, stop and say so. Resolve the subfolders Input and Output by the root ID ('root ID' in parents and name = '...' and trashed = false), never by name across the whole Drive. Read every file in Input; a file READ-base-date.txt, if present, sets today's date. Empty Input folder: stop without writing anything.
Write the result, in the OUTPUT FORMAT, to a file HELPARTICLES_YYYY-MM-DD_HHhMM.md (current Brasília clock, never the base date) on disk with Python open().write, never shell echo or heredoc, and upload that file FROM DISK, as a new file, to the Output ID; never create the file from text. Check that it is in Output (parents). If the upload fails twice, answer \"WRITE ERROR\" and stop. Do not delete or move Input. Do not write to any other system.",

# Attached norms in force (Faculdade Horizonte, example)

## Ordinance 07/2026, of 2026-07-01 (fees and discounts)
Art. 3 The 6% early payment discount applies to payments made up to 10 days before the due date.
§ 1 The discount is calculated on the tuition amount, not including fees.
§ 2 In online (distance learning) courses, the early payment discount is 4%, within the same period as the main clause.
§ 3 The discount does not apply to a payment made after the period of the main clause, nor retroactively.

## General bylaws
Art. 58. Enrollment suspension can be requested up to the 30th day of the academic semester, through the student portal, and lasts at most 2 consecutive semesters.
Art. 59. In the first semester of the program, suspension depends on an opinion from the program coordination.

## Curation cycle rules
- Approval deadline: 5 business days after the cycle date, counted as below.
- Subject with fewer than 10 valid tickets (rating 4 or 5): "Below the cutoff" list, with the count, no proposal.

## Counting business days
- Start on the day after the cycle date. Count only business days. Skip Saturday, Sunday and national holidays. The deadline is the 5th day counted.
- National holidays that apply: Jan 1, Apr 3, 2026 (Good Friday), Apr 21, May 1, Sep 7, Oct 12, Nov 2, Nov 15, Nov 20 and Dec 25.
- Example: cycle on Friday 2026-10-09. Oct 12 is a holiday and does not count. Count: Oct 13 (1), Oct 14 (2), Oct 15 (3), Oct 16 (4), Oct 19 (5). Deadline: 2026-10-19.
- Before saving, check each counted day against the list. A holiday cited in the text and counted as a business day is an error.

## Rules with no leeway
- The student's name, student ID (RA), CPF (individual tax ID) and e-mail do not appear anywhere in the output: draft, examples, reason and ALERTS. This also applies to data the student typed in. Use only the ticket number.
- An answer outside the norm still counts in the subject's number of tickets. It only leaves the draft's sources and goes to ALERTS.
- A ticket rated below 4 does not count for anything.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Step 5 of 5 · Use

Replace the sample with your data

Do this
  1. 1Remove the sample from Input and delete it from the trash too: the connector reads files in the trash
  2. 2Replace the sample in the knowledge base with your company's text
  3. 3Every 15 days, on Friday, export the closed tickets rated 4 or 5, with personal data masked, to the Input folder
  4. 4In Edit, turn on the Work Cycle for Friday, every two weeks, or click ▶ after exporting
  5. 5Replace the norms and the list of articles in the knowledge base with the ones in force at your institution; publishing in the help center stays manual
  6. 6After a few cycles, connect Notion to save the drafts and Gmail or Outlook to ask the owner for approval, always with a review before sending
Done when

tickets.csv

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

No article is published without the owner's approval while it involves a rule, amount or deadline: a wrong answer about tuition or enrollment freeze becomes an undue charge and a complaint to a consumer protection agency. An exception that was granted does not become a rule, and a well-rated answer that gave a deadline outside the rule is discarded as a source and flagged to the coordination team. The student's name, enrollment number and financial situation stay out of drafts and examples. Amounts come only from the current attached ordinance, never from the ticket text.

Common mistakes

  • Taking the best-rated answer as the truth; students rate highly whoever grants what they asked for, even outside the rules.
  • Writing in registrar language ("granting of credit transfer request") when the student is asking whether a course they already took counts.
  • Leaving the article without a campus or modality; on-campus and distance learning differ on calendar and enrollment freeze.
  • Keeping two live articles on the same topic, without unpublishing the old one after the update.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Tickets on the 15 frequent topics answered with a linked articlefrom under 20% to 70% to 85% in the next re-enrollment periodestimate based on the described routine
Average age of articles on frequent topicsfrom more than 24 months to under 6 monthsestimate based on the described routine
Drafts accepted by the owner with wording-only corrections70% or more in calibrationcalibration threshold agreed with the area, domain knowledge

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Cycle of 2026-08-14, 1,140 closed tickets rated 4 or 5 analyzed.
Topic: early-payment discount after the due date | 86 tickets | existing article ART-0412 reviewed in 2024-02 | proposal: UPDATE
Reason: ordinance 07/2026 changed the discount from 8% to 6% and the window from 5 to 10 days before the due date; the article cites the old values.
Rule passage: Ordinance 07/2026, art. 3, sole paragraph ("the 6% early-payment discount applies to payments made up to 10 days before the due date").
Draft: "The early-payment discount is 6% for payments made up to 10 days before the due date. After that date the boleto (bank payment slip) is charged at the full amount. The discount cannot be applied retroactively."
Owner for approval: academic finance | deadline 2026-08-21 | source tickets: 5 listed
Topic: enrollment freeze in the first semester | 41 tickets | no article | proposal: CREATE | source: bylaws art. 58 | owner: academic registrar
Topic: North campus library hours | 12 tickets | proposal: DO NOT CREATE (local information, point to the campus page)

ESCALATION
